message.content: Based on the conversation provided, Li Hua did not initially mention making a new friend to Wolfgang before the music festival. The first mention of Li Hua having a new friend appears in the third interaction, where Wolfgang asks Li Hua if he brought a friend to their jam session, to which Li Hua replies, "Hey guys! Quick question, can I bring a friend to our jam session tomorrow night? 🎸" In this exchange, it seems Li Hua only introduced Yuriko as a potential friend to Wolfgang after she had already expressed interest in joining the jam session. The music festival was mentioned in the second interaction, where Li Hua states, "Did you see the poster saying that our town is holding a local music festival? It looks like it can be an opportunity for our band to perform in front of the crowd!" Therefore, Wolfgang was not informed about Li Hua's new friend before Li Hua introduced Yuriko as a potential addition to their jam session.
